_comment: EDIT THIS FILE FIRST. Every page pulls brand name, phone, email and links from here. Change once, run `npm run build`, and the whole website updates.

founder.name: Founder Name
founder.credentials: M.A. Psychology · 12+ years in career guidance
founder.bio: Placeholder bio — replace with the real founder story before launch.

forms._endpointHelp: Leave empty and the form falls back to WhatsApp/email so the site works on day one. Set it to a Web3Forms/Formspree URL, or to /api/lead if you deploy the included backend.

analytics._help: Paste your G-XXXXXXX measurement ID. Empty = no tracking script is emitted (and no cookie banner needed).
